title: Two author-published VRUBench examples from the paper

paper.title: How Do LLMs and VLMs Understand Viewpoint Rotation Without Vision? An Interpretability Study

preparation.task_instruction: Verbatim from Appendix A, with PDF line wrapping removed.
preparation.prompt_layout: Task instruction, blank line, then original Action/Observation history. Blank final Observation:; labels never appended.
preparation.pair_construction: Flip only the final left/right direction while keeping the angle and all previous history unchanged.
preparation.labels: Published clean labels and the published Figure 7(c) donor label are independently verified by rotation arithmetic. The Appendix A donor label is derived using the paper corruption rule.
preparation.sample_selection: Two published examples with distinct clean/donor answers, selected for provenance rather than head effects or model performance.
preparation.scope: These are attributed paper examples. They are not a download of the complete 19,591-instance VRUBench release and cannot reproduce the dataset-average Figure 2(d).

release_verification.hf_unrelated_candidate: SaiPavankumar22/vru-repro-code contains privacy/excess-risk experiments, not viewpoint rotation understanding or VRUBench.
release_verification.conclusion: No author released full VRUBench download located by these checks; the authors announced release at the currently empty repository.
